common.error_generic: The request failed. Check the hub and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter the admin token configured in GIM_HUB_ADMIN_TOKEN or GIM_HUB_ADMIN_TOKEN_FILE.

users.suspend_description: All sessions of {{id}} are revoked and the user cannot sign in until unsuspended.
users.release_description: The handle {{handle}} becomes free for anyone. The user keeps the account without a handle.
users.revoke_description: Device {{id}} is signed out and must authenticate again.

federation.disabled: Federation is disabled on this hub.
federation.allowlist_description_stored: Stored in the hub database and applied immediately.
federation.allowlist_read_only: Managed by the GIM_HUB_FEDERATION_ALLOWLIST file. Edit the file and reload the hub to change it.

lode.not_supervised: This hub is not running under the lode supervisor.
lode.update_description: lode replaces {{from}} with {{to}} and restarts the hub.
lode.restart_description: lode restarts the hub process. Clients reconnect automatically.
lode.rollback_description: lode reinstalls the last good version {{to}} and restarts the hub.

settings.description: Runtime settings stored in the hub database. Environment variables take precedence and are read-only here.
settings.set_by_env: Set by environment. Unset the variable to manage this setting here.
settings.reset_description: The stored value of {{key}} is removed; the default ({{value}}) applies.
settings.clear_description: The stored value of {{key}} is removed.
settings.restart_pending_description: Some saved settings take effect only after the hub restarts.

user_policy.description: Who may register and sign in on this hub. In allow mode only listed users are admitted; in deny mode everyone except listed users. Users not admitted lose their sessions at once, and this hub refuses relay requests made for them.
user_policy.mode_open_description: Every user is admitted; the list is kept but not enforced.
user_policy.mode_allow_description: Only users on the list are admitted.
user_policy.mode_deny_description: Every user except those on the list is admitted.
user_policy.mode_read_only: Set by the GIM_HUB_USER_POLICY environment variable; read-only here.
user_policy.warning_empty_allow_description: Allow mode with an empty list admits nobody: no user can register or sign in. Add users or switch the mode.
user_policy.warning_locked_out_one: {{count}} user of this hub is not admitted
user_policy.warning_locked_out_other: {{count}} users of this hub are not admitted
user_policy.warning_locked_out_description: They cannot sign in, and their sessions were deleted.
user_policy.list_description: Users matched by the mode. Changes apply at once.
user_policy.remove_title: Remove this user from the list?
user_policy.remove_description: {{id}} is removed from the user list. The change applies at once.
user_policy.bulk_description: One user ID per line; # starts a comment. Listed users keep their notes. Nothing is saved if a line is invalid.
